messages:
Maria Lopez: quick follow-up from the postmortem last night — we saw recurring missing spans + bad rollups after the ETL lag. need owners for the remediation tracks. TL;DR: three tracks: span sampling fix, aggregator correctness tests, and ETL backfill + throttling. who can own what and give a rough ETA?

Dan Kim: I can own the span sampling fix. dug into sampling code this morning, looks like we drop prefixes when trace_rate < 0.1 in the new sampler. i’ll have a patch + unit tests by fri EOD.

Ashley Patel: I’ll take aggregator correctness. planning to add end-to-end tests that run the rollup function against golden traces. ETA next wed. will also open a PR with a failing test to pin the bug.

Priya Rao: I’ll coordinate the ETL backfill and throttling policy. need infra help for temporary capacity and a safe backfill window. aiming to place a small backfill next week and a larger run the week after.

Leo Zhang: tagging some specifics — observed that one of the join keys in the rollup job gets coerced to null when event_time is missing, which makes the group_by inconsistent. i can help Ashley with a repro dataset.

Maria Lopez: thanks. action items: @Dan -> span sampler patch, unit tests; @Ashley -> aggregator e2e tests + fix; @Priya -> backfill plan + infra window. Can each of you drop a short checklist in this thread and add owners in the incident board?

Dan Kim: checklist: 1) reproduce locally with sampling=0.05 (done) 2) patch sampler to preserve prefix when truncated (wip) 3) add unit tests for trace_rate edge cases 4) deploy canary to staging. ETA: fri EOD for 1-3, canary monday.

Ashley Patel: checklist: 1) create golden dataset from last incident (Leo helping) 2) write aggregator ref impl for tests 3) fix null-key coercion 4) add CI job for nightly regression. ETA: initial failing test by tmrw, fix by next wed.

Priya Rao: checklist: 1) run capacity estimate + schedule with infra 2) design backfill with streaming window to avoid double-counts 3) run small backfill and diff metrics 4) full backfill with locking + metrics guardrails. Infra pinged for 10am sync tomorrow.

Infra Bot: scheduled: Capacity sync with @Priya Rao on 2832168400 (tomorrow 10:00). Room: infra-conf-2. Reminder will be posted 30m before.

Leo Zhang: adding a note — we should include a regression alert in Optimize that fires when aggregation drift > 0.5% for 24h vs baseline. that'll catch recurrence early. i can open a small alert rule RFC.

Maria Lopez: also, for ownership rotation: if an owner is out >3 days we'll auto-assign to oncall for the track. please update calendar blockers. i’ll also add these three items to the remediation board and set target milestones.

Dan Kim: quick question — what's the preferred canary cluster? staging-2 or canary-llm? thinking staging-2 for sampling patch.

Priya Rao: staging-2 is fine. infra will approve burst there.

Ashley Patel: +1 staging-2. i'll post the failing test link when it's up.

Maria Lopez: perfect. i'll follow up with the remediation board links and a short summary in the postmortem doc. thanks everyone — please keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth. :thumbsup:
